dreamteamer.title: Search
dreamteamer.description: Search over a workspace's own records. `npx dt-find <question>` climbs an effort ladder on a local qmd index: exact words, embeddings, a hedged three-lane query, then the reference graph to close a set such as "everything that points at X". It prints file:line locations, never an answer. Use grep when you can quote the phrase; use this when you have the idea but not the words.
